name: Asella

queries.query: Asella Ethiopia cadastral map parcel land registry official
queries.result: Search found the Asella municipal portal, national/urban cadastral policy material, and the Addis Ababa e-Land viewer. No Asella parcel geometry service or Asella-specific registry map was identified in the returned first-party results.

queries.result: Search returned the Asella municipal portal and general Ethiopian cadastral/e-Land material, but no public Asella parcel layer, ID-plus-geometry response, or local cadastral endpoint.

officialSources.observation: Asella-branded municipal digital gateway was reachable. Its public content describes municipal/editorial and incident functions; no cadastral parcel map, registry layer, or geometry API was exposed. The linked dashboard contains a client-side editorial login gate and explicitly notes it is not server-verified authentication. No login was attempted.

Official-looking Addis Ababa Land Holding Registration and Information Agency e-Land viewer was reachable. The page and current JavaScript identify Addis Ababa e-Land services and city-scoped application/location configuration; no Asella city code, Asella layer, public parcel schema, or anonymous parcel geometry response was exposed.
First-party Ministry of Justice page provides general urban cadastral survey directive material, not Asella-specific registry custody or parcel data.

requests.outcome: HTML was fetched. No parcel/cadastre/GIS endpoint or safe parcel response was present.
Dashboard HTML was fetched and showed a client-side login gate; no cadastral data or public parcel service was exposed. No credentials or login attempt was made.

Viewer HTML and current JavaScript were inspected. The viewer exposes Addis Ababa e-Land service routes and city configuration, but no Asella-specific public parcel endpoint, schema/CRS, or anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.
General urban cadastral survey directive page reached; no Asella registry or parcel geometry returned.

registryBasis: No Asella-specific local registry/cadastre custodian or public parcel service was actually evidenced. General national and Addis Ababa material is not sufficient to set registryFound=true for Asella.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Only general Ethiopian/urban cadastral information and an Asella municipal portal were observed.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No Asella citywide or bounded public parcel dataset was verified.

remainingUncertainty: A local Oromia/Asella land office or an authenticated municipal workflow may hold parcel data outside the inspected public pages. The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted. A zero exact-point hit, map extent miss, login wall, or unusable viewer would not establish citywide absence.
